# Audio sources and licenses

Owner: sound-designer. See `docs/audio-direction.md` §2.

**Every file in `assets/audio/` is generated by the scripts in `art/audio/scripts/`.** They contain no recordings, no samples and no third-party sounds, so they carry no outside license. They are original work of this repository.

## Recordings

None. Any CC0 recording is added only after the director approves it (D-056), and gets a row here.

| File | Source URL | Author | License | Size | Approved |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Tools used to build the set

| Tool | Version on the build Mac | Used for | License of the output |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python | 3.15.2 | All generators | Not applicable: the sounds are computed, nothing from Python is copied into them |
| numpy | 2.5.4 | All generators | Same |
| ffmpeg (built-in Vorbis encoder) | 9.0.2 | Encoding `room_day.ogg` and `room_night.ogg` | Same: an encoder adds no content |
